name: Instrument
line: The page as a piece of warm-grey hardware in Albert Sans with Doto dot-matrix readouts: six modules with status LEDs and graphite displays (the lesson as orange LED bar meters drawn to scale, the explorers' networks on screens, their key figures as readouts), and a knurled rotary dial in a sticky side rail that turns detent by detent to the module you are reading.
notes: Signal orange is used only for the dial pointer, the LEDs and the meters (never as text on the light panels). The dial is a static SVG; JavaScript turns it and lights the module LED, and the index under it works as plain links without JavaScript. Below 860 px the rail gives way to a slim strip at the top with a small dial and the module name. Doto is used only for figures. Albert Sans and Doto are Latin-only; Chinese and Cyrillic fall back to system fonts.
